pages.title: Red hearts · 1/3
paragraphs: It is seven in the evening on February fourteenth in Savannah. Red hearts hang in the windows of a small restaurant. Ana walks in with her partner in a blue dress. Soft candles light every table. A waiter named Marc greets them with a bow. He holds a small leather menu.
“Good evening! Do you have a reservation?” says Marc. “Yes. It’s under Ana Silva, for two.” says Ana. “Perfect. Tonight we have a special menu.” says Marc.

paragraphs: “Great. Is there a dessert for two?” says Ana. “Yes. A chocolate heart to share. Enjoy your evening!” says Marc. Marc leads them to a table by the window.
